beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book therefore preserves a role for exploration and difficult-to-classify contributions.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its chapters ask how institutions can explain selection without fully optimizing inherited preferences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Relevance is useful when competent output has become abundant and attention remains limited.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to examine both the reasons for choosing work and the costs of overlooking it.
